name: chiaki-ng
tagline: Free and Open Source Client for PlayStation Remote Play
blurb: chiaki-ng is the next-generation of Chiaki, adding new features and ongoing support as the original project (Chiaki) is in maintenance mode.
description: chiaki-ng is the next-generation of Chiaki, adding new features and ongoing support as the original project (Chiaki) is in maintenance mode. It is a free and Open Source Client for PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5 Remote Play. It can be used to play in real time on a PlayStation as long as there is a network connection.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
